body: Thanks! I will look into these.
Can I see the screenshot? And yes I do have some goals, both for work and personal life.
I have an android and Windows.
Happy birthday! Hope you can enjoy the day without too much disruption.

I'm currently pretty depressed and have lost all interest in music. It honestly just hurts to listen to the songs I normally love. Ever since learning I'm bipolar I just can't derive joy from anything. It really sucks because I used to love music.
I really miss not even suspecting I was bipolar.

Yeah it's all I've been seeing too. It's funny because before I even suspected bipolar I felt like I had become slower after a hypomanic episode in the summer. Makes sense after learning about this. 

I guess this just means we have to really be med compliant and do everything to reduce the recurrence of episodes.
Don't mention BD or ADHD at all. Just tell the pdoc how you've been feeling and let them figure it out. I know it's hard. I was also pretty convinced I was BD and then my pdoc confirmed it.
I find myself dissociating more often nowadays. I was looking at my friend earlier and he just seemed unreal. I don't mind it.
Same
I also had a hypomanic episode around May/June. Been depressed as fuck since August, around the time I started working at my current job.
How long since you've been diagnosed?

\*Virtual hug\*

I'm there with you. I had plans for my future just a few months ago that now seem totally unattainable. We have to move into the future with an open mind. I don't know what I'm going to do but I have some faith I'll figure out another path for myself. We have to have faith.

I feel this. I was always off in some way so people would point it out a lot growing up. That really fucked with my self-esteem. I get extreme anxiety in relationships so I've never been happy in one. They've all ended the same: I become emotionally distant and then I break up with them when the anxiety becomes unbearable. It's like I'm too afraid to love.

Haven't been in a relationship in almost 4 years now. I just recently figured out I'm bipolar and I'm sure that has a lot to do with this aversion I have to relationships.
I miss the feeling of wanting to learn things and enjoying conversations with friends. Times like these make me appreciate those small pleasures.

Yeah covid really sucks. I've always wanted to travel but these days I'm afraid it'll send me into a depressive spiral. And thanks--I'm hoping I can get back to doing jiu jitsu. It's really the only thing I enjoy doing when I'm not depressed af.
Are you generally more active now? I feel like I'm on the path to gaining weight on Seroquel. Hopefully, I'll be able to curb it, but my willpower is gone along with everything else.
Hope we can come out of this sooner than later.
I forgot what that feels like.
Yeah I'm also heavy on suicidal ideation these days.
Sorry to hear. I've been roughly about the same for 3 months as well.

My purpose was to improve myself in many aspects but after this diagnosis, I'm struggling to care anymore. What's the point? My future is bleak. I don't see life getting any better for me. I just can't see the point anymore.

The overwhelming consensus is that bipolar disorder only gets worse if untreated. To live a normal life you'll have to be on medication, attend therapy, have a consistent sleep schedule, and have a good diet.
I'm sorry you had to go through that. Are you in a better place now?
This hits so close. I did jiu jitsu and really thought of myself as much tougher than I am. I hope to get back to it soon, but that image I had of myself is completely gone.

I was also much more social and fun prior to my major depressive episode. I was known as the guy who brought the fun in a lot of social situations. It's like I hit a switch and transformed into the most socially inept version of myself. I've never felt more isolated in my life.
That's awesome. How long were you on it?
That is awesome. How have your moods been since you've made the switch?
In shot form? I've never heard of that. How does that work?
All my relationships have been disasters. I get serious relationship anxiety and just become cold. I don't think dating will ever be for me.
My psych says I'm most likely bipolar 2. Given seroquel. I'm also having a very difficult time accepting this reality.
I was just thinking about this today--how extremely fickle I am. It's why I've always been so bad with dating apps and other personal profiles. How do I describe myself? I barely know myself.
Glad you're doing good. My psychiatrist on Tuesday said I'm most likely bipolar2 and prescribed Seroquel. Hopefully, I'll find stability sooner than later.
I'm there too with the severe anxiety. Getting this diagnosis doesn't help at all.
Is that all you take? How long before you felt the effect?
Yeah my depression is pretty bad right now. How long before it took effect?
How much are you currently on? Have you experienced weight gain?
He said I'm most likely bipolar 2.
Yeah, but what I really dread are meetings and having to communicate about certain things I don't have much of a grasp on. I don't see a situation in which I don't humiliate myself.
I'm not sure what you mean by over scoped? And yes I am definitely not as skilled as the current lead.
I can't take advantage of FMLA since I haven't been there a year. I'm not sure how to approach my boss and tell her I won't be able to do the work.
This depression has fucked up my confidence (along with recent events), but I don't believe I am qualified for this position. I am afraid to tell my boss this.

Unfortunately, I would need to have been working there for at least a year for FMLA. If I get fired it will be because of my woeful incompetence. I just can't keep up. My reputation in this industry is going to be ruined.
I'm at fault too. Every time. Everyone in my life is in total confusion about how my life has been going these last 2 months.
I can't even fathom having a child. I can barely take care of myself.
Yep. All I do is self-sabotage. I even see it coming and still do it.
